title: Practice 1: Rain falls, time flies, luck comes: the idioms

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Дождь ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) три дня подряд.
exercises.why: **шёл** — past tense (masculine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: It rained for three days on end.

exercises.q: Другим ___ (повезти — to take off (by vehicle)) меньше.
exercises.why: **повезло** — past tense (neuter) of повезти: the perfective of везти, «set out».

exercises.q: Нам просто не ___ (повезти — to take off (by vehicle)).
exercises.why: **повезло** — past tense (neuter) of повезти: the perfective of везти, «set out».

exercises.q: Нам неслыханно ___ (повезти — to take off (by vehicle)).
exercises.why: **повезло** — past tense (neuter) of повезти: the perfective of везти, «set out».

exercises.q: Тому крупно не ___ (повезти — to take off (by vehicle)).
exercises.why: **повезло** — past tense (neuter) of повезти: the perfective of везти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Tom has had very bad luck.

exercises.q: Дождь ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) всю ночь напролёт.
exercises.why: **шёл** — past tense (masculine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Он ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя странно.
exercises.why: **ведёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Мне не особенно ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way).
exercises.why: **везло** — past tense (neuter) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way) тому, кто везёт.
exercises.why: **везёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Нам чрезвычайно ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way).
exercises.why: **везло** — past tense (neuter) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Они ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя странно.
exercises.why: **вели** — past tense (plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Том ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя прилично.
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Я ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя по-идиотски.
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: I've been acting like an idiot.

exercises.q: Том ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя как зомби.
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: Tom was acting like a zombie.

exercises.q: Они ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя как клоуны.
exercises.why: **вели** — past tense (plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Ко всему прочему ещё и дождь ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way).
exercises.why: **шёл** — past tense (masculine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: On top of that, it was raining.

exercises.q: Она ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя агрессивно.
exercises.why: **ведёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Он ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя странновато.
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: He was acting a little strangely.

exercises.q: Том ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя по-свински.
exercises.why: **ведёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Вы ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя неуважительно?
exercises.why: **вели** — past tense (plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
